chunks: There is not a word he utters but an observer is ready (to make note of it).
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the recording of every word we speak?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the dual presence of the Kiraman Katibin angels who meticulously record every utterance, reinforcing the concept of divine omniscience over both public and private speech. It serves as a spiritual reminder for believers to cultivate mindfulness (muraqabah) in their daily conversations, knowing that even casual words carry weight in the final accounting.
